title: 30th Day
categoryChain: Everyday short duas in the month of Ramadhan

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْ صِيَامِىْ فِيْهِ بِالشُّكْرِ وَالْقَبُوْلِ
verses.translation: O Allah, on this day, (please) decide my fasting to be praiseworthy and approved
according to what is pleased by You and Your Messenger,
and decide its parts to be corresponding with its fundamentals,
in the name of our master, Muhammad, and his Household the immaculate.
All praise be to Allah the Lord of the worlds.
